key_insight: A multi-agent system turns natural-language requests into policy-aware data retrieval and processing, achieving 89% task success with zero observed policy violations in its primary benchmark.
engineering_relevance: The architecture offers a way to automate data-space access workflows while checking consumer credentials and contract usage policies.
method: Use LangGraph to orchestrate specialized agents over Eclipse Dataspace Components (EDC).
Expose catalog discovery, contract negotiation and download as tools, gating negotiation on verifiable credentials.
Route downstream work to ML and visualization agents, then verify fulfillment and usage-policy compliance.
evidence_signal: Two 600-run evaluations reported 89% primary task success and, in a separate geographic-access test, 100% blocking of unauthorized requests with 86% verified delivery for eligible consumers.
watch_item: Reliability depends on request phrasing: success ranged from 72% for casual, underspecified requests to 98% for technical requests; verification also hallucinated fulfillment for 1% of unauthorized regional requests despite no logged extraction.
paper_title: Agentic Orchestration of EDC Data Space Retrieval and Natural Language Driven Data Processing
